purpose: Luna World v0.1 modular environment asset replacement contract

source_priority: Blender Studio licensed asset used as reference/source when license permits export into the game
original Blender model derived from approved art direction
Roblox-native primitive only as temporary fallback
rules.lod_policy: prefer silhouette-preserving low-complexity assets suitable for Roblox/mobile

categories.usage: Luna Village outer silhouette and secondary houses
categories.notes: Readable timber/stone fantasy houses; vary footprint and roofline, not scale of the world.
Separate roof modules make recolor and house recombination cheap.

categories.usage: Farm, roads, village edge, goblin perimeter
categories.notes: Straight, broken, corner, gate and damaged variants.

categories.usage: River banks, zone edges, shelves, escarpments and traversal framing
categories.notes: Need small/medium/large silhouettes; do not create unavoidable micro-steps on critical routes.

categories.usage: Meadows framing, village edge and Dark Woodland mass
categories.notes: Several trunk/crown profiles; crowns non-collidable, trunk collision simple.

categories.usage: Spider Hollow, cemetery and shrine mood
categories.notes: Roots/branches must not create hidden collision traps.

categories.usage: Old Cemetery, Fallen Shrine and Ancient Approach
categories.notes: Pillars, broken lintels, wall fragments and rubble compatible as one kit.
Prefer Roblox terrain/material/decal treatment over heavy mesh rows.

categories.usage: Goblin Camp huts, palisades and lookout
categories.notes: Crude timber/leather construction; readable at distance.

categories.usage: Spider Hollow cave mouth and deadwood dressing
